description: This Kotlin source file defines a mock repository class for a fitness application. It provides in-memory data for workouts, badges, profiles, and goals, and methods to retrieve and update this data, including simple persistence through SharedPreferences. It also includes functions for searching workouts and generating mock progress data.

classes.name: MockRepository
classes.description: A mock data repository for managing user profile, workouts, badges, and progress data, with simple persistence for profile and goals.

methods.name: getProfile
methods.description: Returns the current user profile with default values from SharedPreferences if available.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates the user profile data in SharedPreferences and also updates the associated goal.

methods.name: updateGoal
methods.description: Updates the user's workout and calorie goals in SharedPreferences.

methods.name: getDailyOrContinue
methods.description: Retrieves a list of workouts categorized as 'Daily' or 'Continue'.

methods.name: getRecommended
methods.description: Provides a list of recommended workouts based on the user's profile, specifically their weekly workouts goal and age.

methods.name: getBadges
methods.description: Returns a list of predefined badge objects.

methods.name: getWorkouts
methods.description: Returns the list of all predefined workouts.

methods.name: searchWorkouts
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive search over workout titles, categories, and intensities based on the query string.

methods.name: recentProgress
methods.description: Generates a list of recent progress entries for the past 7 days, with mock calorie and minute data.
